idCitation.resTitle: EPA Tribes (3 of 6): American Indian Reservations

dataIdInfo.suppInfo: This layer is built by combining boundaries from the 2023 Census American Indian/Alaska Native/Native Hawaiian Areas (AIANNH) data (visit https://www.census.gov/geographies/mapping-files/time-series/geo/tiger-geodatabase-file.2023.html for details) with Federally recognized Tribal Entity Names as provided by EPA's Tribal Identification web service (found at https://www.epa.gov/data/tribal-identifier-data-standard). Additional data elements are provided from the 04/24/2024 Tribal Entity spreadsheet. The new information includes Assigned States, Assigned Regions, Lead Region, Current Use Flag, Comments and Name Change History. The relationships between Tribal Areas and Tribal Entities were built during earlier work by EPA's American Indian Environmental Office (AIEO) while developing the Tribal Information Management System (TIMS), and updated to account for the latest Tribal Area and Tribal Entity additions.
dataIdInfo.idPurp: This layer is used to support EPA's analysis of regulated facilities, and environmental monitoring stations with regard to existence on or near Tribal lands.
dataIdInfo.idAbs: This layer represents locations of American Indian Reservation lands in the lower 48 states as well as Alaska. The areas include all Reservations associated with Federally recognized tribal entities.

The AIANNH feature class name is AmericanIndian_AlaskaNative_NativeHawaiian.

prcStep.stepDesc: Create a new feature class of Federally Recognized Reservations areas from the American Indian, Alaska Native, Native Hawaiian (AAIANNH) layer. This is performed by: Part A--sub-setting the layer by running this query: (CLASSFP IN ('D0','D1','D2','D3') AND COMPTYP = 'R' AND FUNCSTAT = 'A'). Part B--create one to many join of old production features with new elements added from updated EPA Tribal Names Service dataset. Note that joins to Census data require GEOID and joins to EPA Tribal Names require EPA_ID. Resulting feature class includes duplicated features for joint use areas.
Added Lead EPA Region data element, and info from 04/24/2024 update to the EPA Names Service spreadsheet. Same update used update State, Region and Comments elements.
